behavior.remote_target: Uses grpc-js system-trusted TLS credentials by default.
behavior.loopback_target: Uses plaintext for recognized localhost/loopback targets.
behavior.custom_credentials: Caller-supplied ChannelCredentials take precedence for all targets.
behavior.private_plaintext: Can be explicitly selected with credentials.createInsecure() from @grpc/grpc-js.

limitations: Credential selection is unit-tested; no remote TLS server or external CA was contacted.
